name: Fort Collins Group
address: 2040 Nancy Gray Ave, Fort Collins, CO 80525, USA
notes:
This is a hybrid meeting. Doors for the meeting open at 9:00am and the online meeting begins shortly thereafter. The Zoom meeting has a waiting room for security purposes.

The business meeting for the Fort Collins Group is held on the 3rd Sunday at 9:00am, prior to the meeting. Doors open at 8:45am on those Sundays.

We celebrate sobriety birthdays on the fourth Sunday of each month, except for months with five Sundays. When a month has five Sundays, the fourth Sunday is a speaker meeting and the fifth is the birthday meeting.

Want to chair the meeting? One year of sobriety is required. Please contact Paula at 970-420-8876. You do not have to be a home group member to chair this meeting.

Please feel free to contact Dondi with any other questions pertaining to this meeting. We hope to see you there!

Zoom meeting ID: 834 1056 2286
Having trouble accessing the Zoom meeting? Text or call Dondi at (970)889-1853.

This group used to meet at the hospital (PVH).
